fields.summary: The shipit work plan for task 2: the log's foundations as library packages (internal/id, canon, entry, store) plus a format-1 corpus, all test-first, with no new CLI commands. Decided (D1-D19, agent wording accepted by the owner): library only, with repo.json, Init and Open in the library and genesis init left to task 6; IDs are ULIDs in canonical upper-case Crockford base32, from oklog/ulid/v2; TDD with table tests, rapid properties and a fuzzed entry decoder; format 1 allows only integer JSON numbers; strings escape only what JSON requires, raw UTF-8, no HTML escaping, no normalisation, invalid UTF-8 rejected; reading is strict, so bytes must be exactly canonical and duplicate keys and unknown envelope fields are rejected; body is any JSON object, typed bodies being task 3's; writes are atomic and never overwrite (temp file, fsync, hard link, fsync the folder); the reader collects every per-file problem, keeps good entries and returns a stable order; the corpus may be amended until the first tagged release and is add-only after; the envelope rules (v, required ULIDs, UTC second-precision at, a sorted unique after list, nine entry types, an object body); repo.json's canonical shape, with Init refusing an existing .genesis/; no check between a ULID's time and at; the reader reports every stray file or folder under log/ and skips only dot-prefixed temp files; the corpus lives under testdata/corpus/format-1 and loads with zero problems. Out of scope: CLI commands, folding, handles, fractional keys, the index, projection, check. Nothing left open.
fields.title: Shipit plan, milestone 1 task 2: log foundation
